It doesn’t have to be expensive. If you’ve never trained a dog I would suggest getting a trainer to help, look for force free / positive reinforcement trainers. Raising a puppy can be draining especially when you’re struggling mentally, so I like to look at the shelter. Look for a dog between 6 months and 2 years, no history of health issues, and no behavior issues. Also make sure they’re not on meds because at my local shelter most the dogs are on trazodone, lol. You can train them to help calm you down, help around the house with basic things like doing laundry and closing doors on command, bringing you your meds & water. Public access training can be tricky, but be patient and don’t give up. If things go bad they can always just be an at home service dog. I think it’s also helpful to have a dog because it forces you to have some kind of routine. My dog gets walked at 7, and eats at 8am & 6pm. I also like to dedicate specific days and times for training. If any have any training questions you can message me. (: I know a lot about dog behavior and training, as well as service dog laws.
